SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.close_date, cs.format,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date IS NOT NULL THEN f.week_ending_date END) weeks_in_stock,
 count(f.store_key) rows_
FROM dim_store cs
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=cs.store_id
LEFT JOIN fact_stock_week f ON f.store_key=s.store_key AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-05' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key AND p.category='Paint & Decorating'
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING weeks_in_stock<5 OR cs.close_date IS NOT NULL OR rows_=0
ORDER BY 1

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period AS period, COUNT(*) AS weeks, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_at_cost_eur
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1, 2
